description.value: A family-owned waterfront hotel in Sidney, BC, operating since 1963 and situated at the foot of Beacon Avenue with direct beach access — the only hotel on Southern Vancouver Island with that distinction. Cyclists will find dedicated secure bike storage with e-bike charging, on-site laundry, and complimentary continental breakfast included with every room. The property sits close to the Sidney ferry terminal and is surrounded by shops, restaurants, and ocean-discovery attractions.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 35m; rack (8 spaces) at 52m; stands (5 spaces) at 84m; rack (4 spaces) at 87m. Total: 22 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Guest Information and Amenities page explicitly states 'Secure Bike Storage with EV Bike Charging Capabilities,' confirming both secure bike storage and e-bike charging. Laundry (complimentary on-site washer/dryer) and Wi-Fi (ultra-fast, password-protected in all rooms) are confirmed in the amenities subpage. Contact details on the website contact page (9775 First St., 250-656-1131) match OSM exactly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating waterfront hotel with a live website, confirmed contact details, and multiple cyclist-relevant amenities including secure bike storage with e-bike charging.
enrichment_extras.notes: Bike storage details page was referenced as 'see below for more information' on the amenities subpage but that section was truncated in the fetched content; specific storage arrangement (e.g. locked room, shed) could not be confirmed beyond the 'secure' label.
